question: Find users who have posted at least one post with 1000 or more views and whose total number of posts is at least twice the number of votes they have cast. Return their display names and the ratio of their post count to vote count.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
       CAST(pc.post_count AS REAL) / vc.vote_count AS ratio
FROM users u
JOIN (
  SELECT p.XCL_033 AS uid, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  GROUP BY p.XCL_033
) pc ON pc.uid = u.XCL_052
JOIN (
  SELECT v.XCL_070 AS uid, COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS vote_count
  FROM votes v
  WHERE v.XCL_070 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.XCL_070
) vc ON vc.uid = u.XCL_052
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM posts p2
  WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p2.XCL_030 >= 1000
)
AND pc.post_count >= 2 * vc.vote_count

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
       CAST(pc.post_count AS REAL) / vc.vote_count AS ratio
FROM users u
JOIN (
  SELECT p.XCL_033 AS uid, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS post_count
  FROM posts p
  GROUP BY p.XCL_033
) pc ON pc.uid = u.XCL_052
JOIN (
  SELECT v.XCL_070 AS uid, COUNT(v.XCL_066) AS vote_count
  FROM votes v
  WHERE v.XCL_070 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.XCL_070
) vc ON vc.uid = u.XCL_052
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM posts p2
  WHERE p2.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p2.XCL_030 >= 1000
)
AND pc.post_count >= 2 * vc.vote_count
